Add file → Create new file → index.html → COLAR TODO este HTML (logo base64 já dentro) → Commit. 4. Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch main / root → Save. 5. Actions aguardar 1-2 min verde → https://<username>.github.io online. 6. Mais páginas app1/index.html. 7. Upload files. 8. Domínio próprio Settings → Pages → Custom domain. Teste logo aparece, calculadoras CRM 250=22€, no-show 100=14€, botão Ollama verde.
